title: Warranty Terms
text: Laptops carry a 2-year manufacturer warranty covering hardware defects, excluding accidental damage and battery wear below 80% capacity after 12 months. Headphones carry a 1-year warranty covering electronic and battery defects. Kitchen appliances carry a 1-year warranty on electrical components and a 5-year warranty on the motor for stand mixers and food processors specifically. Furniture carries a 3-year warranty against structural defects in materials or workmanship; fabric wear, staining, and finish fading from sunlight exposure are not covered.
